Problem / Evidence: Asset register includes encryption, Defender and patch exceptions
Recommended Action: Remediate non-compliant devices and establish weekly exception review
Business Benefit: Reduces avoidable security and support risk

Problem / Evidence: User access register includes overdue and Review exceptions
Recommended Action: Validate with managers and remove unnecessary permissions

Problem / Evidence: Security review shows restore testing is not documented
Recommended Action: Define backup owner, retention and quarterly restore test

Problem / Evidence: Repeated support categories can generate repeat tickets
Recommended Action: Publish guides for MFA, Outlook, OneDrive, printers and project-folder access
Success Metric: 10 published articles; repeat tickets trend down

Problem / Evidence: Manual onboarding and offboarding can miss access or licences
Recommended Action: Use one approved checklist and sign-off workflow
Use one intake channel with ticket ID, category and priority
Reconcile device owner, location, status and warranty each quarter

Problem / Evidence: Operational data is difficult to interpret in raw tables
Recommended Action: Publish monthly helpdesk, asset and security KPI dashboard

Problem / Evidence: Unused licences may remain after role changes
Recommended Action: Compare assigned licences with active users and reclaim unused licences
Annual training plus short quarterly reminders
